name: BC Atlas Sync
brief: Business Central side of bc-atlas-sync: records a business process (clicks, data writes and AL call stacks), builds fact snapshots and generates the documentation that bc-atlas-sync syncs into BC Atlas.
description: BC Atlas Sync is the Business Central side of bc-atlas-sync. It records a business process - user clicks (imported Page Scripting recordings), every database write of the recording session together with the full AL call stack, and optional sampling-profiler call trees. A recording is condensed into an Atlas Sync Fact Snapshot - a fingerprinted set of facts (UI steps, technical steps, objects, methods, data footprint, drift against the previous snapshot) - from which every registered documentation type is generated. bc-atlas-sync syncs that documentation into BC Atlas.
